title: GrowthBook gradient panel (v2)
description: The soft, light-filled gradient frame the original puts behind every product shot: violet, mint, sky, navy or teal washes with faint hairline guides near the edges. Empty, it is the media placeholder; children sit on top (a screenshot frame), or a media prop replaces it.
notes: radius, size and aspect ratio come from the className you pass
name: growthbook-v2-panel

props.name: tone
props.description: the wash: violet (default), mint, sky, navy or teal

props.name: grid
props.description: faint hairline guides near the edges, as on the original's product frames

props.name: media
props.description: a real image or video; replaces the wash when given

props.name: children
props.description: things placed on top of the wash (e.g. a screenshot frame)
